|---|---|---|

| ServerError | HTTP 5xx returned by the API | yes |

| Exception | Raised when | Retryable |
|---|---|---|

| RateLimitError | HTTP 429 returned by the API | yes, after delay |
| ServerError | HTTP 5xx returned by the API | yes |
